faq.q: What is a titanium ion implantation electrode?
faq.a: A titanium ion implantation electrode is a precision-machined ion implant component used in ion extraction electrode disk for implanter. Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium ion implantation electrode?
faq.a: Titanium Ion Implantation Electrode is manufactured to ASTM F136 / ISO 5832-3 (Ti-6Al-4V ELI) or ASTM F1295 (Ti-6Al-7Nb) for medical implants. This requires oxygen <0.13%, iron <0.25%, and 100% traceability with MTC per batch.

faq.q: How is titanium ion implantation electrode manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Ion Implantation Electrode is manufactured using Precision CNC turning. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium ion implantation electrode?
faq.a: The most common issue is stress shielding from modulus mismatch between implant and bone. Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
